items.name: Total company backlog, quarter ended June 26, 2026
items.claim: WSP's backlog climbed 23% to a record CA$20.1 billion from CA$16.3 billion during the quarter ended June 26, representing 11.6 months of revenue, according to WSP's own management discussion and analysis.
items.source_excerpt: Revenue rose 20% to CA$5.4 billion ($3.9 billion) during the quarter ended June 26, compared with CA$4.5 billion a year earlier, according to WSP’s management discussion and analysis . Backlog climbed 23% to a record CA$20.1 billion from CA$16.3 billion, representing 11.6 months of revenue.

items.name: Microsoft data center construction portfolio (SAT89, SAT90, Castroville TX)
items.claim: WSP is involved in nearly $6 billion worth of data center construction in North America, including several projects for Microsoft Corporation such as the addition of buildings SAT89 and SAT90 at a campus in Castroville, Texas.
items.source_excerpt: The company already is involved in nearly $6 billion worth of data center construction in North America, including several projects for Microsoft Corporation , such as the addition of buildings SAT89 and SAT90 at a campus in Castroville, Texas .

items.name: Data-center segment revenue and sales-pipeline growth, H1 2026
items.claim: WSP's data center revenue grew more than 20% year over year during the first half of 2026, while its data-center sales pipeline expanded approximately 30% year over year.
items.source_excerpt: Data center revenue grew more than 20% year over year during the first half of 2026, while its sales pipeline expanded approximately 30% year over year.

items.name: U.S. nuclear site support, prospective pipeline
items.claim: WSP is supporting 22 prospective U.S. nuclear sites, with responsibilities including site selection, licensing, design and construction support.
items.source_excerpt: WSP is also supporting 22 prospective U.S. nuclear sites, where its responsibilities include site selection, licensing, design and construction support.
